author: Bellular News
description:
Steam is still the best store in gaming. That is what makes this worse. Great games are getting buried, wishlists are failing, and even people who helped build Steam discovery say the whole system is more broken than ever. So let's talk about why the games you would love may never reach you.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
